svg.title: 12 · Source-Free Deployment Contract, Mount Guards & Multi-Tier Backup
svg.desc: Modern Athenaeum deployment and disaster recovery diagram for iqoqo v1.2.0 showing Path A Host Checkout and Path B Source-Free DEPLOY_DIR converging into shared pre-flight mount guards, UID 10001/10002 invariants, destructive script guards, and the 4-stage cloud_backup.sh DR pipeline.
svg.text: 12 · Source-Free Deployment Contract, Mount Guards & Multi-Tier Backup
iqoqo v1.2.0 • Dual Deploy Topologies, Non-Root UID 10001/10002 Mount Probes, Production Guards & S3 Glacier DR

g.text: • Runs directly from developer or server git repository (app/, frontend/, tests/)
Re-encrypts cloned preview InstanceSettings with target SECRET_KEY
• ZERO source code checkouts — real files only (no external symlinks)
make deploy-validate • make deploy-sync • make deploy-maintain [--prune]
Preserves data/, exports/, covers/, gallery/ & prunes old .env.bak.* snapshots

svg.text: Shared Pre-Flight Mount Guards, Secret Hardening & Destructive Locks

g.text: (never prints or writes RUM token to disk)
• Fails fast before Gunicorn/Celery start if write probe fails
